details: Municipal archival account identifies the address and the east side of historical Empress Street, provides two measured exterior dimensions, dates the opening and fire, and confirms the 1925 Stanley Cup win.
Contemporary Victoria Daily Times construction report, 5 October 1911, describes the large wood truss space, dimensions, and separate engine house. Written facts used.
Oak Bay historic permit index permits corroboration of the arena site and Thomas Hooper design.
